title: 認証基盤 (ローカルユーザー + セッション + 初期管理者ウィザード)

planning_decisions.decision: Execute the three Stories without splitting. S1e7eeb-1 (data model + argon2id), S1e7eeb-2 (session + middleware + login UI), S1e7eeb-3 (setup wizard Step 1) each map to one user-facing behaviour.
planning_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #7 (段階的実装). MFA / WebAuthn / SAML / LDAP are explicitly out_of_scope_permanent in VISION.json — no temptation to fold them in.

planning_decisions.topic: Session strategy: opaque cookies, not JWT
planning_decisions.decision: Sessions are server-side opaque tokens (32 random bytes, base64url) stored in a sessions SQLite table. JWT for the future /api surface is deferred to a later sprint.
planning_decisions.rationale: VISION tech_constraints_phase_1 says session cookies for UI / JWT for API hybrid. Opaque tokens give real revocation (logout = update revoked_at), avoid JWT key rotation surface, and match the priority #5 信頼性 rule (no broken auth invariants).

planning_decisions.decision: Default Hasher uses t=2, m=19MiB, p=1 with 16-byte salt and 32-byte output. Parameters embedded in PHC encoding so per-row rotation is possible without schema change.
planning_decisions.rationale: OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet (2024) minimum recommended argon2id parameters. Achievable on raspi-class NAS hardware in well under a second. CLAUDE.md priority #5 (信頼性) requires argon2id (not bcrypt/PBKDF2).

planning_decisions.decision: Password verifier lives on auth_methods, not on users. A user row holds identity; an auth_methods row holds a credential. Method values 'password' / 'oidc' / 'passkey' are constrained at the table level so future federation sprints can attach an oidc method to an existing local user without a schema change.
planning_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority #1 (config.json SSOT) — keeps the user model stable across sprints. priority #9 テスタビリティ — Hasher is interface, store accepts a fake.

planning_decisions.decision: kura_session is HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax + Path=/ + Max-Age=604800 (7d). Secure flag is wired through Deps and toggled by KURA_SECURE_COOKIES env var (false on LAN HTTP, true once TLS is on in S822961).
planning_decisions.rationale: OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet minimum sensible defaults. SameSite=Lax (not Strict) so post-login navigations from external apps still carry the cookie. HttpOnly so XSS in /ui/admin templates can't read the token.

planning_decisions.decision: Two roles total: admin and user. /ui/admin requires admin; /ui requires user-or-above; /setup requires zero admins. No permission matrix.
planning_decisions.rationale: VISION out_of_scope_permanent excludes fine-grained RBAC for v1. priority #8 明示的 — keep the rule trivial.

planning_decisions.decision: Implement Step 1 (admin creation) only. Sidebar shows 4 steps total (admin / storage / share / done) with steps 2-4 marked 'todo'. Storage / Share steps land in S99702c per ROADMAP.
planning_decisions.rationale: Sprint description constrains Step 1-2 (sic). Closer reading: only admin creation is implementable without storage/share engines. Followed scope guidance (defer storage/share to S99702c) and showed remaining steps as todo so user mental model is preserved.

planning_decisions.decision: VerifyPassword runs the (failing) hasher even when the username doesn't exist so timing is constant across (a) unknown user (b) wrong password.
planning_decisions.rationale: Standard mitigation. Without it, an attacker times the response to enumerate valid usernames before phishing them.

planning_decisions.decision: The wizard's POST handler re-runs CountByRole(admin) inside the request before INSERT. Closes the race where two browser tabs open /setup, then both POST.
planning_decisions.rationale: priority #5 信頼性. Without the re-check the system invariant 'at most one fresh-install admin via wizard' could be silently broken.

planning_decisions.decision: Authored login.e2e.spec.ts / setup-wizard.e2e.spec.ts and matching .mock.spec.ts files documenting the contract, but do not run them in this sandbox. Acceptance gating is carried by the Go acceptance suite at tests/acceptance/auth_flow_test.go which boots the real gateway + SQLite.
planning_decisions.rationale: Same constraint as S464e47 (Playwright runner not installed). The Go integration test exercises the same HTTP contracts so AC gating is real, not aspirational.

planning_decisions.decision: Authored docs/sprint-logs/S1e7eeb/gui-spec.json with 6 scenarios covering all 5 acceptance criteria + endpoint contract table.
planning_decisions.rationale: Sprint runner contract: gui-spec is mandatory for GUI sprints.

planning_decisions.decision: Both use a new templates/layouts/auth.tmpl (no admin sidebar). Login is center-shell card; Setup is wizard-shell two-pane (sidebar progress + main column). Both load /ui/static/kura.css so design-system tokens are unified.
planning_decisions.rationale: VISION visual_spec_source = prototype/claude_design/. Setup.html in the prototype is wizard-shell; login pages elsewhere in the prototype use center-shell. Reused vocab verbatim — no new design.

implementation_decisions.decision: Added 0002_users.sql with users / groups / user_groups / auth_methods / sessions tables. Foreign keys ON, sessions indexed by (expires_at) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL for cheap active-session listing.
implementation_decisions.rationale: store.Open already runs every embedded migration in sorted-version order; no glue code needed. CLAUDE.md: 副作用は interface 経由 — migrations stay declarative.

implementation_decisions.decision: Types (User, Group, AuthMethod, Role) + Store (CreateLocalUser, GetByID, GetByUsername, CountByRole, VerifyPassword) + Hasher interface + argon2id implementation all live under engine/user/. Public surface is small; all DB shape stays inside the package.
implementation_decisions.rationale: Mirrors the engine/* layout in ARCHITECTURE.md.

implementation_decisions.decision: Single Store with Issue / Lookup / Revoke. Session token == sessions.id row PK; no separate token-to-row map. WithClock + WithTTL exist for tests; production main.go uses defaults.
implementation_decisions.rationale: priority #9 テスタビリティ. priority #3 単純さ — a 32-byte random token IS the lookup key, so there is no second index to maintain.

implementation_decisions.decision: authBundle has SessionResolver + UserLookup interfaces (defined in this package). requireRole / requireNoAdmin / requireAdminExists are the three middlewares. Resolved User is attached to the context behind a private key; PrincipalFromContext exposes it to downstream handlers.
implementation_decisions.rationale: Gateway must not cross-import engine/user types into its handler signatures (cyclic-dep risk). Defining the resolver/lookup interfaces locally + accepting any implementer matches the SOLID 'depend on interfaces' rule and stays easy to fake in tests.

implementation_decisions.decision: Added a /ui handler in internal/ui/Routes() that renders a minimal centered card. Lets the user-role middleware actually permit /ui without /ui being a 404. Real portal lands in a later sprint.
implementation_decisions.rationale: Without it AC-S1e7eeb-2-3 (/ui returns 200 for user role) cannot pass. priority #8 明示的: do not pretend an endpoint works when the handler is missing.

implementation_decisions.topic: Tailwind: ported form / wizard CSS into kura.css
implementation_decisions.decision: Extended internal/ui/src/kura.css under @layer components with .field / .input / .center-shell / .wizard-shell / .wizard-aside / .wizard-step / .wizard-main / .wizard-eyebrow / .wizard-title / .wizard-lead / .wizard-foot — copied from prototype/claude_design/shared/shared.css.
implementation_decisions.rationale: Visual SSOT. Tailwind output regenerated via make ui-css and committed (S464e47 convention).

implementation_decisions.decision: Added 28 new MessageID constants (MsgLogin* x10, MsgSetup* x18) plus matching ja.json keys. i18n-coverage.sh now reports 62 keys (was 34) and still passes.
implementation_decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES forbidden #2 — no hardcoded user-visible Japanese.

implementation_decisions.decision: Gateway mounts /login + /setup directly (with appropriate role / no-admin gating); they are NOT wrapped by requireAdminExists. /healthz is also unauthenticated.
implementation_decisions.rationale: Otherwise a fresh install would 302-loop /setup → /login → /setup. priority #8 明示的.

implementation_decisions.topic: Session cookie is set even when /setup creates the admin
implementation_decisions.decision: POST /setup/admin issues a session for the new admin and lands them on /ui/admin/dashboard. Failure to issue a session falls back to /login with the user already created.
implementation_decisions.rationale: UX: Step 1 should end with a working management console, not a detour through login. Failure mode picks safety: degrade to login rather than report a confusing partial-success state.

implementation_decisions.decision: Did not touch the existing listtables placeholder; left it empty. Auth flow acceptance lives in tests/acceptance/auth_flow_test.go (a Go test that boots the gateway).
implementation_decisions.rationale: S464e47 used the same pattern. Avoids gratuitous churn.

review_decisions.decision: No MFA/WebAuthn/SAML/LDAP/SCIM code. No external plugin loading. argon2id (not bcrypt/PBKDF2). No raw Japanese in templates (i18n-coverage.sh: 62/62 PASS). config.json export does not include user passwords (auth_methods is intentionally NOT in the config.json schema yet — it would carry hashes; that surface lands when the engine/user ApplyAdapter is added in a later sprint).
review_decisions.rationale: VISION + DESIGN_PRINCIPLES forbidden lists. CLAUDE.md: 'アプリの内部秘密 ... を config.json export 時に平文で含めない' — currently observed by simply not exposing auth_methods through the config schema.

review_decisions.topic: Username enumeration vs invalid-creds error message
review_decisions.decision: Wrong password and unknown user return the same translated message ('ユーザー名またはパスワードが違います') and the same 401. Hasher runs in both paths.
review_decisions.rationale: Industry standard. Sneaks zero info to the attacker.

review_decisions.decision: Booted bin/kura on port 18281 with a fresh sqlite db; verified GET / -> 302 /setup, POST /setup/admin -> 302 dashboard with Set-Cookie, GET /ui/admin/dashboard with cookie -> 200, GET /setup after admin -> 302 /login, POST /login wrong -> 401, POST /login right -> 302 dashboard.
review_decisions.rationale: Acceptance criteria are about the running binary. Go integration tests + this manual smoke test give two independent signals.

warnings: User / group ApplyAdapter for config.json import/export is NOT registered in this sprint — Users field in config.json stays empty (UsersConfig{} placeholder from S464e47). Adding it touches the secret-redaction story (CLAUDE.md: 平文で含めない); deferred to a follow-up sprint where a clear password-export policy is decided.
/ui (user portal) is a one-page stub — login as a role=user account works but the only content is brand + tagline. Real portal is a later-sprint feature.
JWT for /api is not in S1e7eeb scope (UI half only). The gateway has no /api routes yet, so this is not a regression.

No password-strength policy beyond min-length 8. NIST SP 800-63B-4 deprecates class-mix rules and recommends breach-corpus checks; that lands when a dependency on a corpus (haveibeenpwned k-anon API or local hash list) is decided.
Session cookie Secure flag defaults to false (LAN HTTP). In production behind TLS (S822961) operators must set KURA_SECURE_COOKIES=1.
/setup wizard sidebar shows 4 steps but only Step 1 is interactive. UI is honest about the deferred scope (deferred_note message).

test_summary.smoke_test: pass — binary boots on portman-allocated port, fresh DB redirects to /setup, full setup → login → dashboard cycle exercised against the running binary
